name: Expert_AML_Stoch
summary: This EA uses a custom CML_Stoch indicator (a modified Stochastic oscillator combined with a moving average filter) to generate trading signals within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on configurable signal thresholds, employing fixed lot sizing with no trailing stop mechanism.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义的CML_Stoch指标（结合修改版随机震荡指标和移动平均过滤器）在MQL5标准库EA框架内生成交易信号。它根据可配置的信号阈值开仓和平仓，采用固定手数仓位管理且无追踪止损机制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于CML_Stoch指标，这是一种将传统随机震荡指标（Stochastic）与移动平均线相结合的自定义信号过滤器。入场条件由Signal_ThresholdOpen（默认40）和Signal_ThresholdClose（默认20）控制，当信号强度超过开仓阈值时开仓，低于平仓阈值时平仓。随机指标参数为K周期3、D周期36、慢速周期25，这种短K长D的配置意味着指标对短期价格变动敏感但平滑线反应较慢，倾向于捕捉超买超卖区域的反转信号，属于均值回归策略。仓位管理采用固定手数（MoneyFixedLot，默认0.1手），不根据账户余额动态调整。资金管理设置了10%的百分比参数，但实际使用固定手数，止损和止盈水平均设为0，依赖信号阈值平仓而非硬性止损，这在风险控制上存在明显缺陷。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the CML_Stoch indicator, a custom signal filter that combines a traditional Stochastic oscillator with a moving average. Entry conditions are governed by Signal_ThresholdOpen (default 40) and Signal_ThresholdClose (default 20), opening positions when signal strength exceeds the open threshold and closing when it drops below the close threshold. The Stochastic parameters are K-period 3, D-period 36, and slowing period 25, which means the indicator is sensitive to short-term price movements while the smoothed line reacts slowly, tending to capture reversal signals in overbought/oversold zones, classifying it as a mean reversion strategy. Position sizing uses fixed lots (MoneyFixedLot, default 0.1 lots) without dynamic adjustment based on account balance. Money management sets a 10% percent parameter but actually uses fixed lot sizing, and both stop loss and take profit levels are set to 0, relying on signal thresholds for exit rather than hard stops, which represents a significant risk management deficiency.

pros: 基于标准库CExpert框架构建，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
使用自定义CML_Stoch指标结合随机指标和移动平均，具有一定的策略创新性
信号阈值机制提供了灵活的入场出场控制，可适应不同市场条件
pros_en: Built on the standard CExpert framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
Uses a custom CML_Stoch indicator combining Stochastic and moving average, offering some strategic innovation
Signal threshold mechanism provides flexible entry/exit control adaptable to different market conditions
cons: 止损和止盈均设为0，完全依赖信号阈值平仓，极端行情下可能造成巨大亏损
固定手数仓位管理不考虑账户规模变化，无法动态调整风险敞口
无追踪止损机制（使用TrailingNone），盈利头寸无法锁定浮动利润
缺少点差过滤器，在均值回归策略中高点差可能侵蚀利润
无新K线检查机制（EveryTick=false有所缓解但不够严谨）
cons_en: Both stop loss and take profit are set to 0, relying entirely on signal thresholds for exit, which can cause massive losses during extreme market conditions
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account size changes and cannot dynamically adjust risk exposure
No trailing stop mechanism (uses TrailingNone), profitable positions cannot lock in floating profits
Missing spread filter, which can erode profits in a mean reversion strategy where high spreads are detrimental
No new bar check mechanism (EveryTick=false mitigates this somewhat but is not rigorous enough)
improvements: 添加硬性止损和止盈设置，作为信号平仓的安全网，防止极端行情下的失控亏损
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率调整手数大小
添加追踪止损模块替换TrailingNone，以保护浮动利润并改善盈亏比
improvements_en: Add hard stop loss and take profit settings as a safety net beyond signal-based exits to prevent uncontrolled losses during extreme market conditions
Implement dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account balance and ATR volatility
Add a trailing stop module to replace TrailingNone, protecting floating profits and improving risk-reward ratio

risk_points: 止损止盈均为0，极端行情下无硬性保护措施，可能导致巨额亏损
固定手数不随账户变化，亏损后风险比例自动升高，存在过度杠杆风险
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护，在流动性差的市场中可能以不利价格成交
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are both 0, providing no hard protection during extreme market conditions, potentially leading to massive losses
Fixed lot size does not adapt to account changes, automatically increasing risk ratio after losses, posing over-leveraging risk
Missing spread filter and slippage protection, may execute at unfavorable prices in low-liquidity markets
